sn21.11:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Maha-Kappino yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || || 3
sn21.11:1.3: Addasā kho Bhagavā āyasmantam Mahā-Kappinaṃ dūrato va āgacchantaṃ || || 4
sn21.11:1.5: Passatha no tumhe bhikkhave etam bhikkhum āgacchantaṃ odātakaṃ tanukaṃ tuṅganāsikanti || ||
sn21.11:1.7: Eso kho bhikkhave bhikkhu mahiddhiko mahānubhāvo || ||
sn21.11:1.8: Na ca sā samāpatti sulabharūpā yā tena bhikkhunā asamāpannapubbā || ||
sn21.11:1.9: Yassa catthāya kulaputtā sammad eva agārasmā anagāriyam pabbajanti || tad anuttaram brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchi katvā upasampajja viharatīti || || 6
sn21.11:2.2: idaṃ vatvā ca Sugato athāparam etad avoca satthā || ||
